svg.text: FESTIVAL OF TRADITIONAL SPORTS · UNIVERSAL QR LIVE HUB · UI/UX SPECIFICATION
What every visitor sees after scanning the universal QR. The page answers four questions straight away: what
is on now, what is next, where it is, and where the full programme is.
Opens in any browser · no app

g.text: Use Gate A or South Gate while the Parade of Nations passes. Sessions run on time.

svg.text: Event name and ten-colour emblem confirm the official site.

Countries, 30 Sports, Venue map and Updates.
Day X of 3, the date and a live local clock. The red LIVE
counter shows how many locations are live.
Clock drives every Live / Next status on the site
A full-width bar that appears only while Admin has an
announcement published. The visitor can dismiss it; it stays
The next four sessions across all locations with countdowns.
CHANGED badge when Admin edits one.
The featured live demonstration in a large media card: LIVE
badge, country, sport, time slot, venue, countdown and
progress bar. A muted clip or photo plays behind it.

The QR never changes; only the content behind it does.
Mockup content is illustrative. Countries, sports, times and venues are managed in Admin and update live on the public site.
